overview: The afternoon was Love's Labour's Lost at the Theatre, at two of the clock. Your side was Navarre. It went to a good Saturday. You said nothing of the letter until the play was done.

parties.name: William Shakespeare
parties.context: Played Navarre, and said nothing of the morning's call.

assets.name: Love's Labour's Lost
assets.disposition: Played Navarre to a good Saturday

summary: Played Navarre to a good Saturday
